scope: Every distinct (file extension, SHA-256) content is executed once by the archive consumer, with three cold native re-admissions per model. All aliases retain verified hashes. Text controls are inventory-only. Candidate recipes execute twice independently; second-pass validation uses up to three independent processes and is not a timing comparison; each preserved candidate output also matches freshly executed frozen-baseline bytes. This deduplicates repeated identical input contents without dropping any distinct fixture.
